standing: Mechanically checkable adjudication of the selected comparison rows; not a valid whole-design adjudication because neither side has an established decision inventory.

method.name: requirement-entailment with explicit countermodels
method.description: For each selected incumbent proposition, test whether the stated requirement excludes a materially different architecture. Read the forcing field in every cited clean-sheet source rather than inferring force from thematic agreement. Separately apply the rule's scope exclusions and audit whether the selected rows cover the raw decision inputs.
method.differentFromA1: A1 primarily repaired A3's source-reference counts and classifications. B tests logical entailment, splits property from mechanism, and treats input-set coverage as a validity precondition.
method.priorComparisonExposure: NOT BLIND: Agent B saw A1's summary and comparison before this run. No claim of isolated corroboration is made. The value of this run is the different falsification method and the recorded disagreements.

decisions.title: One fact plane; extractors produce facts; rules query facts
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: architecture/01 evidence-compiler center, architecture/04 fact plane, architecture/05 one mechanism. Clean a:D03 is FORCED; b:D9 and b:D11 are PREFERRED; c:D05 and c:D16 are PREFERRED. All support reusable facts, but only a says the exact two-layer shape is forced.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Many consistent questions over one snapshot require shared reusable semantic work, but do not exclude separately versioned analysis models over a shared parser/index and provenance contract.

decisions.countermodel: A shared deterministic parser/reference service can feed two separately versioned analysis models whose evidence and input identities are canonical. This meets scale and consistency without one public fact plane.

decisions.title: Analysis pins an immutable input snapshot
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.SNAPSHOT-INTEGRITY and ProjectSnapshot. Clean a:D02, b:D4, and c:D02 independently bind analysis to content-addressed immutable inputs and reject live mutable reads.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A relationship claim must describe one coherent set of exact bytes even while users and agents edit the worktree.

decisions.title: Analysis is deterministic given declared inputs
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: architecture/02 determinism statement. Clean a:D01,D26; b:D6; c:D03 all make output independent of cache lifetime, parallel arrival, models, network, clock, and undeclared ambient state.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A gateable claim must reproduce under the same declared semantic inputs.

decisions.title: Coverage and indeterminacy are first-class; absence is not could-not-look
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.COVERAGE-ARTIFACT and ARCH.RUN-MULTIAXIS. Clean a:D05,D06; b:D5,D20; c:D06,D07 all distinguish complete absence from unsupported, failed, or unavailable evaluation.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A clean gate result cannot mean both no violation exists and the required analysis did not run.

decisions.title: Policy is separate from detection
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.POLICY-BOUNDARY. Clean a:D15 and b:D30 force independent policy authority; c:D05 marks the object decomposition PREFERRED while c:D24 forces core ownership of policy. The logical boundary converges; its exact object/plane packaging does not.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A team must change severity, enablement, accepted debt, and gate thresholds without changing what an analyzer observed.

decisions.title: Stable finding identity enables net-new gates
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: host-owned fingerprint and baseline identity claims. Clean a:D07,D08,D36-D41; b:D3,D16,D17; c:D12-D15 all require versioned correspondence distinct from display location and message.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Gating only newly introduced debt across edits and upgrades requires a versioned correspondence identity independent of presentation.

decisions.title: An addressable run or assessment record binds inputs to conclusions
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: RunManifest, EvidenceDigest, and latest-is-resolver identity. Clean a:D27; b:D12,D14; c:D01,D09 all produce a canonical durable record rooted in exact semantic inputs and conclusions.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Later verification needs one stable object that binds the analyzed inputs, semantics, coverage, findings, and outcome.

decisions.title: Shared reference and reachability substrate rather than per-capability graphs
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.GRAPH-SUBSTRATE. Clean a:D04,D20 explicitly shares resolved facts but D20 is PREFERRED; b:D34 and c:D16 prefer common fact/DAG machinery. None proves that one graph substrate is the only compliant architecture.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Relationship queries require sound resolved references, but deterministic separately derived indexes can satisfy that requirement when they share snapshot and semantic identities.

decisions.countermodel: Two independently implemented indexes over the same immutable resolved-reference stream can carry complete provenance, equality goldens, and distinct workload-appropriate projections.

decisions.title: Local-first offline execution; hosted systems are not on the result path
decisions.evidence: The product brief requires a downloaded local binary, full offline results, and no service dependency. Clean a:D48,D61; b:D22,D24; c:D29 independently exclude network or hosted authority from analysis. Driver and binary packaging details remain preferred.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Every result must remain available on a laptop and in CI with no network account or standing service.

decisions.scopeNote: Corroborates local/offline authority only, not a particular native packaging format or daemon driver set.

decisions.title: Admitted untrusted analysis logic cannot receive ambient full authority
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.CONFINEMENT-HONESTY plus the conditional authority matrix. Clean a:D51; b:D26,D27; c:D23,D24 all reject unrestricted extension authority, although the exact declarative/WASM/process mechanism is preferred or product-conditional.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: If third-party logic is admitted to inspect proprietary source, the tool must not silently grant it unrelated filesystem, process, secret, or network authority.

decisions.scopeNote: This is conditional on the product admitting third-party executable logic; contribution ontology remains product-owned.

decisions.title: Effectful Probe or simulation is a first-class analysis product
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT and architecture/05 simulation row. None of a:73, b:35, or c:30 decisions proposes executing the analyzed program or an effectful simulation product; their external toolchains are fact producers, not Probe.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: The stated product purpose is deterministic code analysis; no stated requirement entails execution of the analyzed program or an effectful scenario product.

decisions.title: CI receives distinguishable termination classes
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: D9 direction and architecture/07. Clean a:D57,D58; b:D29; c:D25 all force separation of policy failure, indeterminacy, invocation failure, operational failure, and interruption. c marks its exact numeric mapping PREFERRED, not the separation property.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: CI must distinguish bad code, insufficient analysis, bad invocation, and analyzer failure because each requires different automation.

decisions.scopeNote: Corroborates distinguishability, not the current six numeric codes or their precedence.

decisions.title: A baseline or accepted-debt mechanism supports adoption with backlog
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: producer-derived baseline and fingerprint claims. Clean a:D36-D42; b:D16-D19; c:D12-D15 all preserve accepted debt with auditable, versioned correspondence across upgrades.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A team with a violation backlog needs a reviewable way to fail only newly introduced debt without erasing accepted findings.

decisions.title: Execution semantics are lifetime-neutral; deployment choices remain separate
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: R-1's EC-1 semantic direction, not v4 detail. Clean a:D47 and b:D23 force cold-path sufficiency and warm-state non-authority; c:D18 rejects separate daemon and CI semantics while marking daemon shipment PREFERRED.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: The same declared semantic inputs must yield the same evidence and evaluation outcomes whether an invocation starts cold or reuses resident acceleration.

decisions.scopeNote: Only semantic lifetime-neutrality is adjudicated. Whether residency ships, autostarts, or is per-project remains measurement-gated and out of scope.

decisions.title: Tool-created durable copies of user source are a first-class user liability
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: threat-model.v2 V1/V2 and architecture/06 retention. Clean a:D28 prefers digests for size and VCS role, not user privacy; b has no source-retention threat decision; c:D11 prefers complete replay bundles. The privacy-centered proposition is therefore not a MATCH.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Persisting another copy of proprietary source or source-derived PII creates a new disclosure, sync, backup, and deletion surface attributable to the tool.

decisions.forcingRequirement: Any durable tool-created copy of proprietary source or source-derived PII must be explicit, bounded, inspectable, and placed with informed user control.

decisions.title: Resolved configuration participates in analysis identity
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: PlanId and provenance-complete DerivationKey. Clean a:D01,D14,D15,D19; b:D2,D6,D14,D30; c:D04,D17 all bind expanded defaults, rules, parameters, policy, and producer semantics into result identity.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A result cannot be reproduced or compared if effective configuration and semantic defaults are omitted from its identity.

decisions.title: Deep semantic capability exists for a subset of languages
decisions.evidence: Clean a:D04,D52,D68; b:D31,D32; c:D07,D27 all discuss tiered depth, so A3's ONLY-INCUMBENT classification was false. The frozen rule explicitly excludes portability depth and provider languages because the product owner already supplied two deep languages.
decisions.scopeRule: cleansheet-adjudication-rule.v1 Scope: product decisions, including portability depth and provider languages, are advisory only.

decisions.title: Machine-consumed result contracts are public and versioned
decisions.evidence: Incumbent: architecture/07 schema negotiation and VERSIONING direction. Clean a:D32 is explicitly FORCED; b:D15,D17 force machine-readable contracts and version migration; c:D09,D15 force canonical serialization and linked immutable schema migration. Codec and exact field set remain preferred.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: CI, agents, and hosted consumers retain artifacts and therefore require stable version negotiation or typed refusal rather than silent reinterpretation.

decisions.scopeNote: Corroborates the existence and evolution obligation, not every incumbent contract or field.

decisions.title: The system neutralizes environment inputs and records what cannot be neutralized
decisions.evidence: Clean a:D31,D61 and c:D03 require neutralization of locale, collation, timezone, clock, randomness, ordering, path normalization, and ambient environment. Incumbent ProjectSnapshot records environment identity and promises equality under identical environments, but does not make neutralization a system obligation.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Cross-platform reproducibility requires neutralizing environment-dependent semantics and explicitly recording any environmental difference that cannot be neutralized.

decisions.title: Select a bounded Datalog-shaped rule computational class now
decisions.evidence: Clean a:D13 prefers recursion to fixpoint with stratified negation and aggregation. Incumbent architecture/01 explicitly rejects Datalog as a day-one requirement and defers implementation selection behind FactQuery; architecture/09 R-2 requires measurement against a real fact schema and real rules. This is a recorded pre-output disagreement, not ONLY-CLEANSHEET.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: The needed rule expressiveness is not established until representative declared rules are tested against a real fact schema, so choosing one computational class now would freeze an unvalidated public constraint.

decisions.tieBreakerApplied: The incumbent deferral creates fewer irreversible public contracts and fewer day-one moving parts while preserving the ability to adopt a bounded class after valid measurement.

metrics.coverageStatus: UNESTABLISHED — these are selected-row metrics, not whole-design metrics

precommittedInterpretation.selectedRowsOnly: 15/18 in-scope incumbent decisions pass (83.3%) and one of two ONLY-INCUMBENT decisions is removed. If and only if the selected rows were a complete inventory, this would fall in the pre-committed substantially-problem-derived band.
precommittedInterpretation.wholeDesignConclusion: NOT PERMITTED. One additional unselected incumbent failure changes 15/19 to 78.9%, below the fixed threshold. The denominator is not established, so the selected-row result is not robust enough to classify the architecture.
precommittedInterpretation.provisionalMergedDirection: Retain the independently supported spine as candidate evidence; remove Probe from the greenfield architecture; adopt environment neutralization; keep rule computational class deferred; do not seal D9, R-1, retention, or contract detail from this comparison.

coverageAudit.selectionProvenance: The 18 INC rows were selected by Agent 3, author of most incumbent architecture. A1 retained that menu and explicitly recorded residual selection bias.

These examples have no row in either completed comparison, regardless of whether later analysis would map, diverge, or exclude them. Therefore the A1-A9 checker is a row-shape checker, not an adjudication-completeness checker.

knownLimitations: This run is not blind: Agent B saw A1's summary and comparison first. Agreement is not counted as independent corroboration.
The selected comparison menu is incomplete; no exhaustive incumbent decision inventory exists and the 138 clean-sheet rows have not each been classified.
Broad comparison titles sometimes combine a forced property with a preferred mechanism. Scope notes prevent those rows from ratifying the mechanism.
No source-code implementation claim was needed or made; this is a greenfield architecture adjudication.
No architecture or claim status is changed by this provisional comparison.
confidence: high on the denominator failure, scope exclusion, CS-02 recorded divergence, INC-15 classification, and per-source forcing labels; medium-high on the selected-row entailment judgments because decision granularity remains underspecified
